instructions.name: check_departure
docs: Base, anyone. Makes a Boarding car leave when it is due: at once when full; otherwise 30 s
after it first held 5 Players (a step-off never moves that time), with 5 or more aboard,
so a car short of 5 at that time leaves in the call after a 5th boards. Anything else is a
no-op, so a join's transaction can always carry it.

instructions.name: close_car
docs: Base, anyone. Closes a car core has frozen (its receipt exists) or closed (an empty car);
the rent goes back to whoever paid it.

instructions.name: commit_table
docs: Rollup, anyone. Commits the Table to base, paid by the Sponsor: a result's first commit,
or a repeat of a commit that may have been lost, with Block Burst's doubling wait while
the result is younger than core's refund window.

instructions.name: create_fuel
docs: Base, operator. Creates a reserve the operator later empties into the Sponsor.

instructions.name: create_sponsor
docs: Base, operator. Creates the Sponsor that pays commits; `lamports` is its first balance.

instructions.name: create_table
docs: Base, operator. Creates Table `index`, funded for its Vault's rent.

instructions.name: delegate_fuel
docs: Base, operator. Delegates a fuel reserve.

instructions.name: delegate_sponsor
docs: Base, operator. Delegates the Sponsor, once.

instructions.name: delegate_table
docs: Base, operator. Delegates a Table to the TEE validator, once.

instructions.name: draw_callback
docs: Rollup, called by the VRF program only. Keeps the output and the ride it gives in the
Vault if it answers the one outstanding request of this car inside the draw window, and
starts the ride clock.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

accounts.name: request
docs: outstanding request. The account itself need not exist.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Base, anyone. Reads base's committed copy of the car's Table and sends core the result, by
CPI signed by Railcar's authority: the places and early refunds, or a full refund. The
Table must name this car and Match, be over, and hold exactly the car's seated Players.
`remaining_accounts`: every seat page of the car. Closes the car (its job is done).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Pays the settlement receipt's rent in tesoro_core.

accounts.name: table
docs: delegated); its address (from its stored bump), owner and contents are checked in
`finalize`.

accounts.name: receipt
docs: `["settled", match]` (deriving it here too would repeat core's bump search).

instructions.name: init_vault
docs: Rollup, anyone, once per Table. Creates the Vault as an ephemeral account behind a private
permission with no member; the Table pays its rent. It is never closed while the Table
runs.

instructions.name: jump
docs: Rollup, the Player of Table seat `seat`: the wallet of the seat's core Account or the
seat's key (`tesoro_core::util::acts_for`, as core checks a seat's signer). Before
the Impact slot the Player is off: the Jump takes the next place in the order. At or after
it the Jump does not count: the ride ends with the Player aboard. When the last Player
aboard Jumps, the ride ends then. A Jump that finds the rollup stalled (the outage rule)
voids the ride and is not recorded. `car_no` makes a transaction held back from an earlier
ride worthless on a later one.

accounts.name: player
docs: The seat's Player: the wallet of its core Account, or the seat key core recorded for it.

instructions.name: open_car
docs: Base, the opening Player. Opens the next car (core's many-seat open for 500 Gemas, 5 to
100 seats, signed by Railcar's authority) when no car can still take seats. The opener
boards with core's join like everyone else, in the same transaction.

accounts.name: boarding_match
docs: read by hand in `still_boarding`.

instructions.name: refill_sponsor
docs: Rollup, operator. Moves lamports from a fuel reserve into the Sponsor.

instructions.name: request_draw
docs: Rollup, anyone. Asks again when no answer came within `DRAW_RETRY_SLOTS`, at most
`MAX_DRAW_REQUESTS` in all, never once the draw is in.

instructions.name: set_config
docs: Base, upgrade authority only. Names the operator and the number of Tables; the number is
fixed once the first car opened (a car's Table is `car_no % tables`).

instructions.name: signal
docs: Rollup, anyone (each open page sends one about every second). Moves the public Tell
stage; from the Impact slot on it ends the ride and commits the Table. A draw that never
came voids the ride once its window is over, and so does a rollup that ran under half
speed for 5 s during the ride (the outage rule, judged before the Impact).

instructions.name: skip_car
docs: Rollup, anyone. Passes over the Table's next car when it will never ride: it was closed
(core froze or closed its Match), its Match is gone, or core has frozen it.

instructions.name: start_ride
docs: Rollup, anyone. Puts the Table's next car on it once that car has left: copies its seated
Players from every seat page (remaining accounts) and asks for the draw. A Table whose
last ride is over is reset first, once core has frozen that car (its receipt).

accounts.name: previous_receipt
docs: `receipt_at`.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the upgrade authority may do this

errors.name: NotOperator
errors.msg: Only the operator may do this

errors.name: BadConfig
errors.msg: Invalid configuration

errors.name: BadTableSlot
errors.msg: That Table index is not allowed

errors.name: InvalidValidator
errors.msg: Delegation must name the TEE validator

errors.name: CarBoarding
errors.msg: A car is still boarding: board it

errors.name: WrongCar
errors.msg: Not this Table's next car

errors.name: NotDeparted
errors.msg: The car has not left

errors.name: PagesMissing
errors.msg: A seat page of the car is missing

errors.name: WrongPhase
errors.msg: Not valid in this phase of the ride

errors.name: VaultMissing
errors.msg: The Table has no Vault yet

errors.name: VaultExists
errors.msg: The Table already has its Vault

errors.name: DrawNotDue
errors.msg: No draw request is due

errors.name: StaleRequest
errors.msg: The randomness answer is not for the current request

errors.name: NotAPlayer
errors.msg: Not a Player of this ride, or not this seat

errors.name: AlreadyJumped
errors.msg: Already off the car

errors.name: StaleBinding
errors.msg: The instruction names another car

errors.name: PreviousNotFrozen
errors.msg: Core has not frozen the Table's previous car yet

errors.name: BadTable
errors.msg: Not the car's Table, or the Table has no result for it

errors.name: SeatsDiffer
errors.msg: The Table's seats differ from the car's

errors.name: NotFrozen
errors.msg: Core has not frozen this car yet

errors.name: CannotSkip
errors.msg: That car may still ride

errors.name: CommitNotDue
errors.msg: No commit is due

errors.name: SponsorDry
errors.msg: The Sponsor cannot pay a commit

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

types.name: Car
docs: One car: the core many-seat Match it boards and the Table it rides on. On base, never
delegated; the rollup reads it. Closed once core froze its Match.

fields.name: tables
docs: `Config.tables` when the car opened: the car after it on the same Table is
`car_no + tables`.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid this account's rent; it goes back there when the car closes.

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: Trusted for now to supply the issuance price and `YieldAccrued`/`PositionLocked` facts.
This is the seam for the LayerZero receiver (messages) and Pyth (price).

fields.name: platform_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Platform Fee.

fields.name: legacy_games
docs: Unused since the per-Game records; its bytes stay so older accounts keep their layout.

fields.name: leaderboard_bps
docs: Leaderboard Fee in basis points of the Pot. Appended after `games`: an account created
before it reads the fields as zero (the unused tail of the account is zeroed) and is
extended by `init_leaderboard`.

fields.name: pool_account
docs: The Leaderboard Pool: `TesoroAccount` owned by the `["leaderboard"]` address. Zero until
`init_leaderboard`; the fee is off while it is.

fields.name: leaderboard_since
docs: Unix time `init_leaderboard` first ran: Matches opened before it were not charged the fee, so
readers show the fee only for Matches opened at or after it. Zero until then.

fields.name: entry_sizes
docs: Entry sizes in Gemas, zero-padded. All zero until `set_entry_sizes`: the default ladder
(100 / 500 / 1,000) applies, so an older Config needs no call. Appended after the Leaderboard
fields: an account created before reads them as zero from its zeroed tail.

fields.name: oracle_locked
docs: Set by the admin on mainnet (`set_oracle_lock`): the oracle key can no longer register
Positions, report their yield or name an Advance's price (test-mode paths), so a stolen
oracle key cannot mint Gemas. Appended last: an older Config reads it as false.

types.name: EconomyConfig
docs: Who may do what in the economy upgrade, as explicit settings (never the oracle authority).
Seeds `["economy"]`; created by the admin's `set_economy`.

fields.name: season_keeper
docs: Runs Seasons (`fund_season_prize`, `record_season`, `pay_season_rank`) besides the admin.

fields.name: fill_keeper
docs: May fill Instant Redeem orders while `keeper_fills` is on (the admin always may).

fields.name: keeper_fills
docs: Off by default: only the admin fills.

fields.name: pool_share
docs: The Pool's share of every realised Yield Fee, changeable from a Season announced ahead.

fields.name: routes
docs: Custodies whose prize escrow `record_season` waits for (zero = unused slot).

fields.name: tesoro_studio
docs: The Account that receives the Studio Fee counters of Tesoro's own Games (`cash_in_fee`);
zero until the admin names it.

types.name: Fuel
docs: A delegated lamport reserve the operator empties into the Sponsor inside the rollup.

types.name: GameRecord
docs: One Game. Registered once by whoever controls its program (see `registry`); changed only by
that same control, after `GAME_CHANGE_DELAY_SECS`. Listing is written by the admin.

fields.name: game
docs: The Game program's id.

fields.name: settle_authority
docs: Only this key may settle the Game's Matches (a PDA of the Game program, or a server key).

fields.name: studio_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Studio Fee.

fields.name: pending_at
docs: Unix time a proposed change was made; zero while none is waiting.

fields.name: pending_by
docs: The control key that proposed it. Applying needs the same key to be in control still.

fields.name: listed_until
docs: The Game counts as listed until this unix time (admin). Zero: never listed.

fields.name: approved_slot
docs: The deploy slot the admin approved. A program upgraded since has a different slot and
counts as unlisted until the admin approves again.

fields.name: approved_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the approved build's executable bytes without trailing zeros (`registry::code_hash`).
A moved slot keeps the listing only through `refresh_listing`, which proves the bytes are these.

fields.name: listing_epoch
docs: Counts the builds the admin approved: bumped by `list_game` only when it sets a different
hash, never by `refresh_listing`. A Match remembers the epoch it opened under, so a moved
deploy slot with the same epoch is the same build.

fields.name: seat
docs: The core seat index.

types.name: ManySeatMatch
docs: A many-seat Match (ADR 0015) at the same address as a head-to-head one,
`["match", opener Account, n]` with the opener's `next_match`, so its id, overflow records and
receipt work like a head-to-head Match's. Read in place (no Borsh, see `ManySeatRecord`). The
seats are in `SeatPage`s.

fields.name: listing_epoch
docs: `GameRecord.listing_epoch` when the car opened (little endian).

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the rent of this account; it goes back there when the Match is closed.

types.name: ManySeatRecord
docs: The many-seat Match record (`state::ManySeatMatch`), read and written in place.
Byte arrays only (alignment 1, no padding), and no Borsh: a record that shared `MatchId`,
`MatchMeta` or `Terms` Borsh code with the head-to-head `MatchState` changed how the
head-to-head settle chunk was compiled (its 12-step worst case rose 24-30 CU), so the
many-seat path keeps its own layout and builds those values through accessors.

fields.name: opener
docs: The id: the opener's Account and its `next_match` (little endian).

fields.name: settle_authority
docs: The Game's settle authority when the car opened: only it departs and settles.

fields.name: first_min_at
docs: When `seated` first reached `min_seats`; never cleared (a Game's fixed departure time).

fields.name: seated
docs: Seats taken right now.

fields.name: pages
docs: Seat pages created so far (always in order, page `pages` is the next one).

fields.name: receipt_bump
docs: Canonical bump of the car's receipt `["settled", match]`, found once at open so settling
checks the address with one hash instead of a bump search.

fields.name: refund_after
docs: From departure: anyone may refund the car from this time on (`settle::start_refund`).

fields.name: run
docs: The run (ticket 03), fixed when settling starts. See `settle`.

types.name: PlaceSlot
docs: One place as the run keeps it: who is paid, and how much.

fields.name: player_share_bps
docs: The Player's Offer share of a Backed seat's winnings (0 unbacked).

types.name: PoolShare
docs: The Pool's share of every realised Yield Fee, changeable only from a Season announced ahead.

fields.name: next_from
docs: First Season the pending change applies to; 0 = none pending.

types.name: RailcarConfig
docs: Railcar's settings and its one boarding line. The upgrade authority names the operator and
the number of Tables (fixed once the first car opened, since a car's Table is
`car_no % tables`).

fields.name: next_car
docs: The number the next car gets.

fields.name: boarding_match
docs: The core Match of the car boarding now (default before the first car).

types.name: RideRunning
docs: The draw is in and the ride clock runs from `ride_slot`.

types.name: RideSeat
docs: One seat of a ride, public. Byte arrays only (alignment 1).

fields.name: seat
docs: The seat's index in the core many-seat Match.

fields.name: order
docs: 0 while aboard, else the Player's place in the Jump order (1 = first off).

fields.name: jump_ms
docs: Ride time of the Jump, real ms since the ride clock started.

fields.name: refund
docs: Gemas of the entry the result refunds (written when the ride ends).

fields.name: account
docs: The Player's core Account.

fields.name: signer
docs: The seat key core recorded for this seat at join (`Seat::signer`, seat-keys decision D4),
copied by `start_ride`. The Player's wallet acts for the seat too (`acts_for`).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for the Brake (ticket 07).

types.name: RideSettled
docs: `finalize` handed the result to core (event-CPI).

types.name: SeatRun
docs: The frozen plan of a many-seat run and its cursor, read in place inside `ManySeatRecord`.

fields.name: in_seat
docs: 1 once the cursor entered `seat_i` (its `seat_left` is loaded).

fields.name: visited
docs: Seated seats the home phase has passed.

fields.name: line_i
docs: Home phase: the next line to look at; forfeits phase: one past it (walked backward).

fields.name: seat_left
docs: Gemas the current seat still moves in this phase.

fields.name: won_left
docs: Gemas the current place still gets, and of them the Backed Player's share still owed.

types.name: Sponsor
docs: A program-owned lamport holder, delegated once, that pays the commits as the fee payer.

types.name: Table
docs: A Table: one ride at a time, delegated to the TEE validator and kept for months. Public: who
boarded and who is aboard, the Jump order, the Tell stage, the ride start, the entry (the
Gemas at stake are `entry * seated`) and the outcome. Read in place (no Borsh): a signal comes
several times a second and touches a few bytes. Byte arrays only (alignment 1, no padding).

fields.name: tell
docs: Tell stages passed (0 none, 1 screws, 2 bolt and panel, 3 sparks and creak).

fields.name: false_screws
docs: False screws passed.

fields.name: places
docs: Table seats of the places, last Player off first (`NO_SEAT` when unused).

fields.name: vault_ready
docs: The Vault exists (`init_vault`).

fields.name: dirty
docs: A result waits for its first commit.

fields.name: next_car
docs: The car this Table takes next (`car_no % tables == index`, strictly in order).

fields.name: car
docs: The Railcar `Car` account and its core Match.

fields.name: started_slot
docs: Slot of `start_ride` (the draw window runs from here).

fields.name: ride_slot
docs: The ride clock: slot and time of the draw's arrival.

fields.name: over_ms
docs: Ride ms and unix time at the end.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for the reveal (ticket 07).

fields.name: pace_slot
docs: The pace mark: slot and time of the last moment the ride was on pace (outage rule).

fields.name: authority
docs: Solana wallet that controls the Account.

fields.name: evm_address
docs: The EVM family address of the Account (zero until set).

types.name: Vault
docs: The private half of a ride: the VRF output and what it decides. A rollup-only account behind
a private permission with no member, created once per Table; nobody reads it during a ride.

fields.name: car_no
docs: The car the draw below belongs to.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for the Brake schedule and the reveal (tickets 07, 08).
